from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancialData(BaseModel):
    """A single company's financial data extracted from one report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The full name of the company")
    total_assets: float | None = Field(description="Total assets value at the end of the reporting period, numeric only")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g. '2024 Q1'")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="The currency of the reported amount")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    companies: list[CompanyFinancialData]
